svg.title: What to count before you order
svg.desc: Three things to count before the order: IBM i on subscription-term licensing, in the P20 Standard and P30 Enterprise editions; the IBM Bob Premium Package for i, per authorized user; watsonx Code Assistant for Z, whose license unit we confirm with IBM.
